name: shalaby-rules-tests
description: Firestore security rules tests against the local emulator (kept apart from the app because of the emulator tooling).

scripts.test: cp ../firestore.rules . && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-shalaby --only firestore "node --test rules.test.mjs"
scripts.e2e: cp ../firestore.rules . && firebase emulators:exec --project shalaby-group --only firestore,auth "node app-e2e.mjs"
